newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT to accept cash on delivery in Germany.
newsitem.headline: TNT to accept cash on delivery in Germany.

text.p: TNT Express GmbH, the German express goods division of global integrator TNT Worldwide Express, is now accepting cash payments for deliveries.
Cash on delivery (COD) payments of up to 4,000 marks could now be taken in addition to the previous cheque payment method, a statement said.
The COD service was in particular oriented to the computer and electronics industries, office and entertainment equipment firms and the financial sector, it added.
Payment would be forwarded to the consignor one day after delivery while security would be ensured through in-house checks.
